prior_restaurants = get_results_from_cache(key="previous_restaurants")

# Search for hotels in Portland with the specified check-in and check-out dates and number of rooms
hotel_results = search_hotels(
    city="Portland",
    checkin_date=["May 31, 2025", "May 31, 2025"],
    checkout_date=["June 10, 2025", "June 10, 2025"],
    num_rooms=2,
    num_people=2
)

filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotel_results,
    neighborhood=["Portland"],
    cuisine=["Icelandic"]
)

# Find the nearest restaurants to the filtered hotels
nearest_restaurants = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    restaurants=prior_restaurants,
    groupBy="restaurant"
)

# Save the results to the cache
save_to_cache(key="hotel_with_nearby_icelandic_restaurants", value=nearest_restaurants)
